tasks.title: Move product jobs into their owner repos
tasks.description:
Problem

These product jobs run scripts kept outside any repo. pstack is silent on them, but nobody owns them.

Decision

Keep each job. Move its script and unit into its owner repo.

Fix

  1. Name the owner repo for each job.

  2. Move the script and unit file there.

  3. Point the timer at the repo copy.

Risk

A job could break during the move. Move one at a time.

Done when

  • The audit rerun shows none of these items.

  • Proof is on this ticket.
